findings.title: Dublin street-block crisis recede is mutation-vacuous — no gate can fail when it is deleted
findings.detail: The PR's recede family includes 'the Dublin street blocks', but no test, palcheck leg, or golden renders Dublin blocks under an active zone crisis: only dublin_board.dem uses the Dublin map (captures at 30s/90s — pool-only crisis, factor 0) and juice/a11y scenes are procedural (sprite path). Perkins probe: deleting the block recede keeps the FULL corpus green (49/49). Per the round's mutation doctrine a claimed recede surface that cannot fail any gate is a blocker.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a palcheck §7 leg (or dedicated fixture) with map_source=Dublin + an active Saturated_Bundle row, pixel-scanning a non-involved street block for the receded alpha; RED-then-GREEN mutation leg.

findings.title: Re-blessed golden goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png missing from the PR body's cause table (6 changed, 5 documented)
findings.detail: 'Exactly 6 crisis-carrying T2 frames' but the table lists 5 — the a11y_scale@65s row (same juice-scene cause: the demo IS the juice scene at ×1.50 with the crisis banner) is absent. Verified: git diff --stat shows 6 golden PNGs changed incl. a11y_scale (93968→95879). The cause-documentation contract (briefing item 5) under-counts.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the sixth table row: goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png — same frame at UI scale ×1.50 (scaled chrome legibility leg).

findings.title: New crisis_packet_involvement_chain test leaks its loaded Catalogs (leak WARNs in odin test output)
findings.detail: The test deletes its catalog SOURCES but never calls pp.catalogs_destroy — violating the package convention its sibling spawn_fx_test.odin follows (7× 'defer pp.catalogs_destroy'). odin test app/render prints '+++ leak 17B [catalog.odin:...]' for it.
findings.recommended_fix: Add defer pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat) matching the spawn_fx_test convention.

findings.title: palcheck scan_col/scan_box index px at cx without an x-bounds guard
findings.detail: scan_col guards yi but reads px[yi*img.width+cx] with unguarded cx (scan_box checks both axes correctly). A fixture/camera drift pushing the scan column off-screen is a latent out-of-bounds read in shipped harness code.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror scan_box's guard: skip when cx < 0 || cx >= int(img.width).

findings.title: Dublin frontage-edge recede scales a line-primitive alpha — inert under the rlsw line-alpha trap
findings.detail: edge.a = u8(90 * crisis_recede_scale(recede)) feeds DrawLineEx, but rlsw renders line alpha opaque (in-repo canon: spawn_fx.odin:449, view.odin:670) — the edge recede cannot affect goldens; on GPU it may. The block FILL (DrawTriangle) carries the real recede.
findings.recommended_fix: Either redraw the frontage edge as a thin filled rect (fill alpha blends in rlsw) or drop the line's recede scale as dead.

findings.title: Primitive-fallback building recede diverges from the sprite path (and exceeds the spec's closed recede list)
